scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Whoa, long time no see! But weren't you supposed to be dead?
scripts.translation: 哇，好久不見！不過你不是應該已經死了嗎？

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Ah, you must have been reborn. Well, I'm glad to have you back.
scripts.translation: 啊，你一定是轉生了。很高興你回來了。

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
I'm sorry, but I don't think you're ready to learn magic yet. Why don't you go finish learning the Basic Skills first?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我覺得你還沒準備好學習魔法。不如先把基本技能學完？

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Take your time. The more you learn, the more ready you'll be to learn magic again.
scripts.translation: 慢慢來。學得越多，就越有準備再次學習魔法。

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Well, since you have passed the Mage test once, I will not question your qualification. You want to have your magic skills back immediately, don't you?
scripts.translation: 既然你通過過一次魔法師測驗，我就不再質疑你的資格了。你想馬上恢復魔法技能，對吧？

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Wow, for some reason, you look way better than you did before. Anyway, I believe you will do a better job being a Mage as well.
scripts.translation: 哇，不知道為什麼，你看起來比以前好多了。不管怎樣，我相信你也能成為更出色的魔法師。

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Is there anything more I can help you with? If not, why don't you go test your skills? The world is waiting for you~!
scripts.translation: 還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？沒有的話，不妨去測試一下自己的技能。這個世界正等著你呢~！

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
What, are you interested in the Mage guild? I didn't want to tell you this, but you don't belong here.
scripts.translation: 怎麼，你對魔法師公會感興趣？雖然不想告訴你，但你不屬於這裡。

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
I am not sure why you're still standing in front of me, but I can tell that you're not meant to be a Mage.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你為什麼還站在我面前，但我看得出來你不適合當魔法師。

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Hey, haven't you realized? You're already a Mage, silly!
scripts.translation: 喂，你還沒發現嗎？你已經是魔法師了，傻瓜！

scripts.text: One of these days you'll realize the power inside of you when you can make Fire with your mind!
scripts.translation: 總有一天，當你能用意念生出火焰時，就會明白自己體內的力量！

scripts.text: Hey~ C'mon. Quit playing games. You can't be a Mage because you already have another Job.
scripts.translation: 喂~別鬧了。你已經有其他職業，不能再當魔法師了。

scripts.text: Hey?
I want to be a Mage
What are the requirements to be a Mage?
scripts.translation: 成為魔法師有什麼條件？

scripts.text: Nothing, thanks.
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage? Eh...
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey, look at you! You're kinda cute~! Not my type though...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，瞧瞧你！還挺可愛嘛~不過不是我的菜...

scripts.text: Oooh, you're such a hot babe~!
scripts.translation: 哇哦，你真是個性感美女~！

scripts.text: I like girls like you~
Right, you said that you wanna be a Mage?
scripts.translation: 對了，你剛才說想成為魔法師？

scripts.text: I want to be a Mage.
Nothing, thanks.
[Mage Guildsman]
Whaaaaat~?! Right after you tell me that you wanna become a Mage, you change your mind?! Be a bit more decisive!
scripts.translation: 什麼~？！你剛說想成為魔法師，怎麼馬上又改變主意了？！拿出點決斷來！

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Oh, man your Basic Skill Level doesn't reach enough to be a Mage.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，你的基本技能等級還不夠，不能成為魔法師。

scripts.text: Go back and level up your Basic Skill.
scripts.translation: 回去提升基本技能等級吧。

scripts.text: Alright.. sign the application form.... Wow~ you have good handwriting! Ahh, okay. That's enough.
scripts.translation: 好...在申請表上簽名...哇~你的字真漂亮！啊，好了，夠了。

scripts.text: You are... {0}.
[Mage Guildsman]
Hmm I can see that you've tried hard in your own way. Though it seems to be a little clumsy, but well I think it's okay!
scripts.translation: 嗯，看得出來你已經盡力了。雖然有點笨拙，不過我覺得沒問題！

scripts.text: Good! Always sticking to the basics is the best! I will transform you right away.
scripts.translation: 很好！打好基礎總是最重要的！我馬上幫你轉職。

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Hahh..! You are now a Mage, one of our colleagues!
scripts.translation: 哈啊...！你現在是魔法師了，成為我們的同伴！

scripts.text: We welcome you to the Mage Guild, our new friend!
scripts.translation: 歡迎加入魔法師公會，新朋友！

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
'Welcome to the Mage Guild~'
Congratulations on becoming a member of the Mage Guild! Go for it!
scripts.translation: 恭喜你成為魔法師公會的一員！加油！

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh?
I'd be happy to explain the requirements for a pretty girl like you!
scripts.translation: 我很樂意為你這樣的可愛女孩說明條件！

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
First of all, you have to reach Novice Job Level 10 and learn all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation: 首先，初學者的職業等級必須達到10級，並學會所有基本技能。

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
In the past, there was a complicated potion making test. Because of that, we'd lost an aplicant slowly.
scripts.translation: 以前有一道複雜的藥水製作測驗，因此申請者逐漸減少了。

scripts.text: So, we decided to accept all aplicants who meet the basic requirements.
scripts.translation: 所以我們決定，只要符合基本條件，就接受所有申請者。

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Don't hesitate. Just be a magician!
scripts.translation: 別猶豫了，成為魔法師吧！

scripts.text: [Mage Guildsman]
Nothing...?
